open_points.subject: K-02 network prohibition versus A03 loopback
open_points.text: K-02 says a function has “no network”; changed A03 says “network(environment) = own_loopback_only” and requires “its own loopback — up”.
open_points.question: Does “no network” prohibit every network interface, or does it permit an isolated loopback interface while prohibiting communication outside the execution?
options: Require no network interface at all
Permit an up isolated loopback interface but no external connectivity
Permit loopback only for sandbox infrastructure, not agent code
open_points.default_guess: Follow the more specific changed A03 rule: permit isolated loopback while socket use by agent code remains a sandbox violation.

open_points.subject: Exact loopback topology
open_points.text: “its own loopback — up” and “network(environment) = own_loopback_only” do not define which interface, addresses, address families, routes or reachable endpoints constitute the required loopback state.
open_points.question: What exact observable network state must an execution have for the invariant and required test 10 to pass?
options: Only an interface named lo with the UP flag
An up lo interface with IPv4 127.0.0.1
An up lo interface with both IPv4 127.0.0.1 and IPv6 ::1
Whatever loopback state the installed bubblewrap and host kernel happen to create
open_points.default_guess: Require one up lo interface with IPv4 127.0.0.1, no non-loopback interfaces and no route outside the namespace.

open_points.subject: Startup validation of the loopback isolation guarantee
open_points.text: The text requires loopback to be up and to reach “nothing outside the execution”, but also says “the kernel does not inspect or verify at run time — the start check (rule 8) asks only that a probe execution succeeds”.
open_points.question: What must happen when the host kernel or bubblewrap produces a network namespace without the required loopback state or with unintended external reachability?
options: Refuse startup after explicitly verifying the namespace topology and reachability
Treat supported bubblewrap and host-kernel behavior as a release prerequisite and specify those prerequisites
Start after any successful probe even if the network invariant is false
open_points.default_guess: Treat failure of the stated topology as a startup failure and extend the probe to verify it, despite the current sentence saying the probe checks only execution success.
